bias.en: Bearish · slipped under the June pivot
bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 6 月转折点

read.en: Intel fell 4.6% on Oct 14 to $98.12 and is down 13% in five sessions. It is below its 5-day ($102.8), 10-day ($109.5), 30-day ($109.0) and falling 100-day ($107.7) averages, and well above the 200-day ($84.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 5 ($116.5), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: 英特尔 10月14日下跌 4.6%，收于 $98.12，五个交易日下跌 13%。股价位于 5 日（$102.8）、10 日（$109.5）、30 日（$109.0）和下行的 100 日均线（$107.7）下方，远高于 200 日均线（$84.0）。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方并在零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 10月5日起看空（$116.5），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The Oct 13 bounce from $98 reversed and the close slipped under the $98.3 June pivot (day's low $97.67). Next support is $94.5 (September low), then $89.6 (Jul 17 low) and $85 (Aug 24 low). Resistance is $98.3–101.3 (June pivot, Oct 14 high), then $103 (5-day average) and $107.7–109.5 (10, 30 and 100-day averages). A close below $94.5 would open $89.6.
